question: Which method is more reproducible and what experiment should be run next?

papers.title: Model A: Efficient Classification (synthetic example)
papers.text: We propose an efficient classification model on a public benchmark dataset. We compared with a logistic regression baseline. Accuracy was 89 percent on the held-out test set. We report random seed 42, hyperparameters, and implementation details. A limitation is sensitivity to distribution shift.

papers.title: Model B: Novel Classification Architecture (synthetic example)
papers.text: We propose a novel architecture that outperforms previous work. Our experiment achieved 94 percent accuracy. We claim state of the art performance but provide no code or data source description.
